status: Narrow sufficient-empty alpha-mask proof verified with existing CPU WASM; no native rebuild, browser, GPU or Figma interaction acceptance.

contract.node_sources: known non-group/text leaf shape, normal blending, zero children/strokes/effects
contract.fill_sources: each fill solid+normal and (visible === false or opacity === 0); no epsilon; entire validated array <=16
contract.resolution: same design_system/components/layout/boolean resolution chain as CPU before guard
contract.cache: existing per-hit excluded map only, no retained state
contract.fallback: unknown/luminance/vector mode, unknown kinds/paints, groups/text/images/gradients/strokes/effects/subtrees keep old geometric proxy

commands: cd frontend/design-client && bun run vite build

performance.method: Same-process original/changed Editor; alternating order,32 warm calls,21 batches; indexed batch16/full batch4; p50/p95 are quantiles of batch-average time, not event latency. Shared cloud Linux/Bun1.4.0.
performance.scene: 18 cases: six mask modes x depth1/8/24 and leaves32/128/256, dense repeated miss;64x64 analytic pixel check.
performance.limits: Control full-query regressions/GC/scheduler variation retained. No universal speedup, no-regression, browser FPS or production p95 claim. At most16 fills per distinct ancestor per hit; no added raster work.

figma_boundary.claim: Official mask rendering semantics support alpha0 hiding content; these sources do not establish pointer-picking behavior. Vector-shaped alpha masks differ from Figma VECTOR mode; Core schema accepts only alpha/luminance.
